Authored synthetic media for the public native movie browser test. No game data.
32x24, 20 fps, 0.6 seconds, red/blue halves and a 440 Hz tone.

Reproduction command (FFmpeg with libvpx-vp9 and libopus):
ffmpeg -nostdin -hide_banner -loglevel error -f lavfi -i color=c=red:s=32x24:r=20:d=0.6 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:sample_rate=48000:duration=0.6 -vf drawbox=x=16:y=0:w=16:h=24:color=blue:t=fill -c:v libvpx-vp9 -lossless 1 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a libopus -b:a 32k -shortest -y tests/fixtures/native-movie.webm

Container metadata may differ between FFmpeg versions. Tests compare decoded
frame continuity and inspect interior color regions, preserving normal YUV
conversion and chroma interpolation at the red/blue boundary.
